verdict.rationale: Weights licensing is a fair question for an LLM provider, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers downloadable weights, a weights license, self-hosting, or an explicit statement that the weights are closed. The fine-tuning docs (SFT/RFT) describe training hosted OpenAI models via the API, which is an adjacent feature and does not make weights available or disclose their status.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can download the model weights under a stated license and run them myself — or the platform is honest that weights are closed
